description: Defines the CookieOptions class and nested SameSiteCookieContext class, including enums and metadata related to cookie security contexts and behaviors in the Chromium project.

classes.name: CookieOptions
classes.description: Configurable options for cookie handling, including security context, HttpOnly exclusion, and access time updates.

methods.name: MakeAllInclusive
methods.description: Creates a CookieOptions instance that includes all cookies, including HttpOnly and SameSite.

classes.name: SameSiteCookieContext
classes.description: Represents the context for SameSite cookie policies, including trust levels and metadata about the context.

methods.name: set_exclude_httponly
methods.description: Exclude HttpOnly cookies from being accessible.

methods.name: set_same_site_cookie_context
methods.description: Set the context for SameSite cookie policies.

methods.name: set_update_access_time
methods.description: Update the last-accessed time for cookies.

methods.name: set_do_not_update_access_time
methods.description: Do not update the last-accessed time for cookies.

methods.name: set_return_excluded_cookies
methods.description: Configure to return cookies that are excluded by options.

methods.name: unset_return_excluded_cookies
methods.description: Configure to not return excluded cookies.

methods.name: set_same_party_context
methods.description: Set the SamePartyContext for cookie handling.

methods.name: set_full_party_context_size
methods.description: Set the size of the full party context for logging.

methods.name: set_is_in_nontrivial_first_party_set
methods.description: Indicate whether the site is in a nontrivial first-party set.
